content.title: Red Lions edge Blue Sharks after a wild extra-time swing
paragraphs: Red Lions won 3-2 after extra time in a match that kept flipping back and forth. Fox opened the scoring in the 28th minute from Lane's assist, Gray levelled for Blue Sharks in the 62nd, and Reid restored Red Lions' lead in the 95th from Rook's pass. Blue Sharks hit back through Cruz in the 105th, assisted by Wells, before Bell's own goal in the 113th settled it for Red Lions.

Red Lions had the better of the game overall, with 4.61 expected goals to 2.48, 27 shots to 15, and 11 shots on target to 7. They also controlled territory and possession for most of the match, finishing with 85 field tilt and 69 possession, while Blue Sharks spent much more time deeper and had to live off fewer attacks.

The turning point came in the final stretch of extra time, when Red Lions kept the pressure on and forced the decisive mistake. Even so, Blue Sharks stayed alive through the equaliser at 105 minutes, and the last ten minutes were chaotic, but Red Lions finished the stronger side and kept pushing until the winner arrived.
